title: 第5258章 烈焰尊主第5257章 绝命毒液
lines: “这是毒液，是‘绝命’毒液，不！”
“该死的，居然是三十万尊主复灵丹一滴的‘绝命’毒液，完了！”
“饶命啊，饶我一命！”
杀戮还在继续！
这必杀名单上面足足有十二名尊主二重强者强者，这十二位尊主二重强者强者分散在幽寒国各处，并未集中在一起，江玄杀戮起来自然要轻松许多。
只是需要花多一些时间去找慢慢找罢了。
原本以江玄的实力，虽然能碾压性的打败那些尊主二重前期强者，但想要把对方直接击杀还是很艰难的。
但因为有了绝命毒液在，他要击杀这些尊主二重前期强者，便轻松许多了。
绝命毒液，被称为尊主三重以下武者的噩梦，这绝不是浪得虚名。
凭借着绝命毒液，在短短不到半个月时间，江玄就辗转了幽寒国各个角落，击杀了名单上面足足六位尊主二重强者。
当然如今被击杀的这六位尊主二重强者，都只是尊主二重前期强者，最强的也就尊主二重前期巅峰强者。
轰！
漫天的火焰不断地喷泄而出。
此处，乃是一片巨大的火山群。
这片火山群遍布都是火红色的大地，周围看不到见到任何生灵或者活物。
咻！
一道身影出现在这片火山群的上空，那是穿着一身紫袍，脸上戴着一个紫色面具的江玄，那双冰冷的眼眸正看着下方。
“烈焰山脉，应该就是这里了，这必杀名单上面十二位尊主二重强者强者，其中实力很强，已经达到了尊主二重中期层次的烈焰尊主，应该就藏身在此。”
江玄喃喃着。
碎星盟给的这份任务情报里，不仅有这十二位尊主二重强者强者的具体信息，还包括他们这些人所在的位置。
那位烈焰尊主，便常年待在这片火山群里，据说已经有几年没有离开了。
“呵呵，闭关几年时间，修炼还挺努力的，只是几年前，这烈焰尊主为了去炼制自己那本命灵兵，生生把一个界域里十分之一的武者都烧成了紫烬，这简直是罪大恶极，绝不可饶恕！”江玄目光冰冷无比。
一座界域，便拿他先前出生的紫凌尊界来说，已经算是十分辽阔了，其中拥有的武者数量何其之多？
一个界域里十分之一的武者，那也绝对是一个天文数字。
一口气焚烧这么多的武者，就为给自己去炼制一件本命灵兵，这份手段又是何等凶残，何等让人发指！
“烈焰尊主，滚出来！”
江玄发出一道厉喝，那声音浩浩荡荡，在这整个烈焰山脉不断回荡，久久没有消散。
在这烈焰山脉的最底下，无尽的烈焰之中，盘坐着一道高大身影猛地睁开双眼，下一瞬便爆冲而起。
轰！
如同火山爆发一般，整个天地都在此时猛地一震。
那道高大身影直接冲出了地面，来到那虚空，来到了江玄的面前。
“他就是烈焰尊主么？”
江玄盯着眼前的人，面色无比冷漠。
烈焰尊主，身影高大如同一座山岳，其身上穿着一套火红色铠甲，头戴红色钢盔，周身环绕炙热的火焰，整个人就像一头火焰巨兽一般。
content_en:
"This is venom, it's 'Death' venom, no!"
"Damn it, it's actually one drop of the 'deadly' venom from the Three Hundred Thousand Lord Lord Restoration Pill. It's over!"
"Spare my life, spare my life!"
The killing continues!
There are a total of twelve powerful masters of the second level of the Lord on this must-kill list. These twelve powerful masters of the second level of the Lord are scattered throughout the Youhan Kingdom and are not gathered together. It is naturally much easier for Jiang Xuan to kill.
It just takes a little more time to look for it slowly.
Originally, with Jiang Xuan's strength, although he could overwhelmingly defeat those strong men in the early stage of the second level of Lord, it was still very difficult to kill them directly.
But because of the presence of Deadly Venom, it was much easier for him to kill these early second level masters.
Deathly Venom is known as the nightmare of warriors below the third level of the Lord, and this reputation is not in vain.
With the help of the fatal venom, in less than half a month, Jiang Xuan traveled to every corner of Youhan Kingdom and killed six second-level masters on the list.
Of course, the six masters of the second level of the Lord who have been killed now are all the masters of the early stage of the second level of the Lord, and the strongest ones are the peak masters of the early stage of the second level of the Lord.
………
Boom!
Flames filled the sky constantly spurting out.
Here is a huge volcano group.
This volcano group is covered with fiery red land, and no creatures or living things can be seen around it.
call out!
A figure appeared above the volcanoes. It was Jiang Xuan, who was wearing a purple robe and a purple mask on his face. His cold eyes were looking down.
"The Flame Mountain Range should be here. The twelve powerful masters of the second level of the Lord on the must-kill list. Among them, the very powerful Lord of the Flame, who has reached the mid-level of the second level of the Lord, should be hiding here."
Jiang Xuan murmured.
The mission information provided by the Broken Star Alliance not only contained specific information about these twelve powerful second-level lords, but also included their locations.
The Flame Lord has stayed in this volcano group all year round, and it is said that he has not left for several years.
"Haha, I have been in seclusion for several years, and I have been practicing quite hard. It's just that a few years ago, in order to refine his own spiritual weapon, the Flame Lord burned one-tenth of the warriors in a realm to purple ash. This is simply a heinous crime and can never be forgiven!" Jiang Xuan's eyes were extremely cold.
A realm, taking the Purple Ling Zun realm where he was born before, is already very vast. How many warriors does it have?
One-tenth of the warriors in a realm is definitely an astronomical number.
Burning so many warriors in one breath just to refine a natal spiritual weapon for himself, how cruel and outrageous this method is!
"Lord Flame Lord, get out!"
Jiang Xuan let out a sharp shout. The sound was so majestic that it echoed throughout the entire Flame Mountain Range and did not dissipate for a long time.
At the bottom of the flaming mountain range, amid the endless flaming flames, a tall figure sat cross-legged and suddenly opened his eyes, then exploded into the air the next moment.
boom!
Like a volcanic eruption, the whole world shook violently at this moment.
The tall figure rushed out of the ground, came to the void, and came to Jiang Xuan.
"Is he the Flame Lord?"
Jiang Xuan stared at the person in front of him with an extremely cold expression.
The Lord of Flames is as tall as a mountain. He wears a set of fiery red armor and a red helmet on his head. He is surrounded by scorching flames. He looks like a giant flame beast.
